name: Crowns and Pawns: Amber Road
storyline: Milda Kovas is accused of stealing a unique amber artifact - the Sun stone. It is believed that fragments of this huge amber were scattered across the Amber Road, and if all the pieces were to be collected, it would grant you arcane powers. Determined to clear her name, Milda must travel to Lithuania, from where she sets off on a continent-spanning road adventure. Milda and her companions will visit beautiful landscapes and mysterious locations, following the legendary Amber Road, from the Baltics in the North, all the way to the Mediterranean. They will meet a diverse cast of local characters, solve riddles and survive chilling threats, while learning about the ties between the old European gods, myths and history.
summary: Embark on a thrilling point-and-click road adventure across Europe. Travel through mesmerizing locations, solve puzzles and survive chilling threats while following the legendary Amber Road. Will you have the wits to uncover the mystery behind the enigmatic artifact - the Sun stone?
